versions.changelog: API key now loaded from a private header file instead of the curl command line.
Use curl --data-binary so request bodies are sent byte-for-byte.
Shell-quoting safety fix: request bodies are now written with quoted heredocs, user text is JSON-encoded, and sent with curl --data @file.json. No API behavior changes.
Chirp section: PostRequest fields, keyless GET /posts read-back, how to chirp a billboard (no billboard ID field), live example
